title: Hermite spectral approximation for functions with endpoint singularities using exponential transforms
summary: In this paper we introduce Hermite spectral approximation for functions with endpoint singularities using exponential transforms, including single exponential (SE), double exponential (DE) and error function (EF) transforms, and present a comprehensive convergence analysis for these approximations without and with scaling. In the case without scaling, we show that these methods converge at some root-exponential rate.
